description: Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 (admin/admin). The June expense policy review has surfaced four issues requiring resolution: (1) the expense category for professional development and conference fees ('Conference Registration') is not configured as a reimbursable expense type — correct this so employees can use it in future reports; (2) a submitted expense report from an employee in the Research & Development department contains a single line item that exceeds the company's $500 per-item reimbursement cap — refuse this report; (3) a separate submitted expense report contains a line item that is a verbatim duplicate of a claim already processed and reimbursed last month by the same employee — refuse this duplicate report; (4) a draft expense report from an R&D employee has been ready for submission for several days — submit it through the workflow and approve it. Open the Expenses module, investigate the pending reports and product configuration, and resolve all four issues.
